Introduction

Olivia Marsh, also known as Gyuna, is a South Korean-Australian singer-songwriter and composer under MPLIFY. She debuted with the song "Lava" on March 31, 2024, which was part of the soundtrack for the JTBC TV show “Hide.” She made her solo debut with the single "42" on October 16, 2024. Olivia is the older sister of Danielle from NewJeans.
